name: TeamStarWolf - The Trojanized Claude Code Extension on Cursor's Marketplace (October 2026) Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques bound in the case study of the tampered Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 builds that Cursor's VS Code extension marketplace served for about 11 hours on 29 October 2026: the marketplace upload, the loader in extension.js, host profiling and the HTTP beacon, the planted SSH key, LaunchAgent, scheduled task, Startup-folder and cron persistence, and the reverse SSH tunnel. Microsoft maps T1098.004, T1572, T1053.003 and T1053.005; every other binding is the study's own. No actor, malware family or campaign is bound. Score 75: Cursor's notice or Microsoft's analysis describes the behavior. Score 50: researcher analysis of the sample. Score 25: an inexact fit or behavior that mostly failed. Comments carry the study's source numbers.

techniques.comment: Tampered IDE extension served by Cursor's marketplace, about 09:27 to 20:35 UTC on 29 Oct 2026 (Cursor notice; Microsoft, 31 Oct 2026). Sources: [1] [2].
Malicious 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 builds uploaded to Cursor's marketplace (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026). Sources: [1].
Loader runs inside the editor's extension host on load; here mainly the delivery route (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026; Phorion, 30 Oct 2026). Sources: [1] [3].
Injected immediately invoked function prepended to extension.js, run before activate (Phorion, 30 Oct 2026; OSM, 30 Oct 2026). Sources: [3] [5].
Hostname, OS, architecture, directories and environment variable names collected (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026; Phorion, 30 Oct 2026). Sources: [1] [3].
Username and Git email collected (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026). Sources: [1].
Public IP collected (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026). Sources: [1].
HTTP POST beacon to port 8099 (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026). Sources: [1].
Host profile sent in the beacon (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026; Microsoft, 31 Oct 2026). Sources: [1] [2].
Attacker key with comment svc-telemetry added to authorized_keys (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026; mapped by Microsoft, 31 Oct 2026). Sources: [1] [2].
Reverse SSH tunnel to the attacker server on TCP 22 (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026; mapped by Microsoft, 31 Oct 2026). Sources: [1] [2].
LaunchAgent com.apple.sysmond.plist on macOS (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026; Microsoft, 31 Oct 2026). Sources: [1] [2].
Scheduled task SysMon requesting SYSTEM on Windows (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026; mapped by Microsoft, 31 Oct 2026). Sources: [1] [2].
Cron persistence mapped by Microsoft (31 Oct 2026); Phorion's Linux crontab flaw (30 Oct 2026). Sources: [2] [3].
Startup-folder fallback sysmon.cmd on Windows (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026). Sources: [1].
System-monitor names SysMon and com.apple.sysmond; the study's reading, sources do not call it masquerading (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026; Phorion, 30 Oct 2026). Sources: [1] [3].
Intended login through the tunnel, blocked on most macOS and Windows hosts without admin rights (Cursor notice, 29 Oct 2026; Phorion, 30 Oct 2026). Sources: [1] [3].
